summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on PR #320, which fixed Grafana Cloud 503 errors in the staging deploy workflow.
summary.outcome: Two of three review comments were addressed (env var validation and fail-fast on 4xx responses) and committed to the branch. One CodeRabbit suggestion for a deadline-based timeout was intentionally declined as over-engineered.

repo: Grafana Cloud free-tier instances require a wake-up polling step before dashboard pushes; the deploy workflow now polls /api/health every 10s for up to 5 minutes.
The staging deploy workflow is at .github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml and contains a Grafana Cloud readiness check around lines 514-531.

code.finding: Env var validation for Grafana credentials was added here per Copilot review comment.
Fail-fast logic on 401/403/404 responses was added here to avoid burning all 30 poll attempts on auth/not-found errors.
CodeRabbit suggested a deadline-based timeout here; declined because attempt-based (30 x ~10s) is sufficient and simpler for a soft 5-min target with sub-second curl responses.

workflow: CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot are both active automated reviewers on this repo.
PR review threads are resolved via GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread; replies use the REST comments endpoint with integer in_reply_to field (--field, not -f).

friction: One CodeRabbit suggestion (deadline-based timeout) required judgment to decline — the automated reviewer flagged a valid concern but the proposed solution was disproportionate to the actual risk.
open_items: Deadline-based timeout approach for the Grafana health poll (CodeRabbit suggestion) was declined but could be revisited if the 5-min soft cap ever needs to become a hard SLA.
